series.pending: pending attempts (admitted, waiting for a node)

series.configured_maximum: configured maximum (declared ceiling, not live nodes)
series.active_tasks: active tasks (attempts running in this pool)
series.pending_requests: pending requests (attempts waiting for this pool)

series.lagging: executions whose archive watermark has not advanced within the limit

series.stale: executions whose newest checkpoint is older than the limit

series.terminal: operator terminal connection (transport only, not liveness)

series.feed_age_ms: age of the newest brain feed

alerts.action: drain the attempt and release its scale down protection; the alert never releases it
find what keeps the request from a node: free room in its permitted pools, resize it, or ask the operator for capacity; the alert never cancels it
check the requester's brain binding; the denial already held and nothing was disclosed
